crossRefs.note: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by…
When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes…
Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
He raises up the poor out of the dust. Lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
Yahweh upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be…
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

translations.web: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
translations.bsb: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
translations.kjv: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
